items.title: Stanley Dance interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: Doubleday was up at the Rainbow Grill and Tope says to Duke, “Well it’s high time we had your book, Mr. Ellington.”

ctx.x: Gee the union was really quite strong.

Well I don’t think we needed to have been as careful as we were about that. When it got back to England, some of the performances were edited down because we’d gotten a little more time than we should have had, but I don’t think we needed to have done that. I don’t think the union has time to check all those you know. But the company didn’t want any trouble there. It wasn’t because of the artists.
